Crystal-clear LED DRL projector headlight pair for Porsche Cayenne 955 (2003-2006), including 2004 models. Complete left and right assemblies with LED daytime running lights and projector low beam. Designed for vehicles with factory Xenon/HID — reuse your original ballasts and leveling motors for installation.

Fitment: Porsche Cayenne 955 2003-2006 (factory Xenon/HID)

Shipping
Worldwide shipping available on headlight assemblies — contact for a quote on international delivery.
